about: The mainnet record the site builds against when NEXT_PUBLIC_BOUNCER_CLUSTER=mainnet (contract/active.ts). INTERFACE 0.32, build bouncer_v32_v3_39e266f4.so (1133112 bytes), the bytes devnet runs since slot 516927005: the program, build and IDL of idl/deployment.mainnet.json, the pending record the final tag carries (A9.9). Pending until the mainnet deploy: deployed_in_slot is 0, so the site signs nothing (the pin check fails closed). The deploy's facts arrive as NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOYED_SLOT (D-P3's slot) and NEXT_PUBLIC_UPGRADE_AUTHORITY, and a redeploy; NEXT_PUBLIC_PROGRAM_SHA256 may only restate this sha256 (other bytes need a reviewed record, a commit). The program id is the devnet one, so its Config and program data account, PDAs of it, are too; active.ts derives them again and refuses a mismatch. on_chain is the fixture's own figures, not a chain read. config holds production's terms (idl/constants.json), which the admin sets after init_config, and the pause flag 1 that init_config sets; emergency_update_pause_ts, admin and lp_owner are placeholders (0 or empty) until the chain read, since init_config stamps the ts with its own clock.
